basic_details.short_information: The Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Maharajganj, has released the KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026 Notification for 96 teaching and non-teaching vacancies in upgraded Kasturba Gandhi Residential Girls Schools. The recruitment covers Principal, Post Graduate Teacher (PGT), Lab Assistant, Office Superintendent/Clerk, Caretaker, Peon, Watchman and Assistant Cook positions on a contractual basis.

However, candidates must enclose three self-addressed envelopes bearing postage stamps worth Rs. 56 each with their application. | The postage stamp requirement is separate from any postal charges incurred while sending the completed application through registered post or speed post.

age_limit.details: The minimum and maximum age requirements will be calculated as of 1 April 2026. Principal candidates must be between 30 and 45 years of age, while candidates applying for other advertised posts must be between 25 and 45 years of age. | Age calculation date: 1 April 2026. Payments will be governed by instructions issued from time to time by the State Project Office, Lucknow. | These are contractual honorarium amounts rather than regular government pay scales. content_sections.heading: KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026 Latest Update – Salary Revised
content_sections.text: The District Basic Education Officer, Maharajganj, issued a corrigendum on 26 November 2026 revising the monthly honorarium for Lab Assistant, Peon, Watchman and Assistant Cook posts advertised under the original recruitment notification dated 25 November 2026. All other educational qualifications, eligibility requirements and recruitment conditions remain unchanged. The last date for receipt of applications continues to be 10 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

content_sections.text: The official KGBV Maharajganj recruitment notification contains the vacancy details, qualifications, selection methods, reservation provisions, application conditions and prescribed application form. The seventh page of the combined document contains the latest salary revision corrigendum dated 26 November 2026. Candidates can visit the official Maharajganj district recruitment page for recruitment announcements and related documents. Check KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026 Notification – Official Website

content_sections.heading: KGBV Maharajganj Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 96 vacancies have been announced across 14 teaching and non-teaching post categories, including subject-specific PGT positions. The recruitment includes 37 PGT vacancies, 15 Lab Assistant vacancies and 16 Assistant Cook vacancies. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease. Post-wise and subject-wise reservation will be determined in accordance with applicable rules and the decision of the district selection committee. The official notification provides reservation details for Unreserved, Other Backward Classes (OBC), Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS).

content_sections.heading: KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The educational qualification requirements differ according to the advertised post. Only female candidates who satisfy the prescribed academic qualifications, age requirements and other recruitment conditions are eligible to apply. Candidates applying for Principal posts must possess the prescribed postgraduate qualification, professional training and relevant teaching or administrative experience specified in the notification. Trained M.A. in Hindi or English, or M.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, Mathematics or Computer Science from a recognized institution. At least four years of teaching experience in Classes 9 to 12 or the prescribed experience as a trained graduate head teacher in a recognized junior high school under the applicable qualification pathway. Alternative qualification pathways involving a postgraduate degree or prescribed postgraduate diploma and relevant teaching experience are also provided in the notification. Candidates must satisfy the prescribed age requirement of 30 to 45 years. The notification specifically requires at least four years of teaching experience in Classes 9 to 12 for Principal candidates under its age and experience instructions. The experience certificate must be duly forwarded and countersigned by the District Inspector of Schools (DIOS). The educational qualifications for PGT and Computer Science teaching positions depend on the subject selected by the candidate. Trained candidates are given preference under the subject-wise qualification provisions. Candidates must meet the exact subject combinations and alternative educational qualification requirements mentioned in the official notification. The notification provides multiple educational qualification pathways for Computer Science teaching posts. M.Tech. in Computer Science. B.E. or B.Tech. in Computer Science from a recognized university. MCA or M.Sc. in Computer Science from a recognized university. DOEACC B-Level qualification under the specified provision. Postgraduate degree with a Postgraduate Diploma in Computer Applications from a recognized university. Postgraduate degree with B.Sc. containing the prescribed Computer Science course component. Postgraduate degree with DOEACC A-Level qualification. The notification also prescribes residential and fitness-related conditions for the posts listed in the support-staff table. Candidates should check the applicable requirements before applying.

rows.educational_qualification: M.A. in Hindi with B.A. including Sanskrit, or the prescribed Shastri examination qualification from the specified recognized institution.
Postgraduate degree in English from a recognized university. Preference for candidates possessing an L.T. Diploma or a recognized degree or diploma in education.
M.A. or M.Sc. in Mathematics, or B.A. (Honours)/B.Sc. (Honours) with the prescribed three-year Mathematics curriculum.
M.Sc. in Botany, Zoology, Life Science or other prescribed subject combinations, or B.Sc. with the specified postgraduate diploma in Biology.
M.Sc. in Chemistry, B.Sc. (Honours) with a three-year Chemistry curriculum, postgraduate qualification in Biochemistry or B.Sc. with the prescribed postgraduate diploma in Chemistry.
M.Sc. in Physics or B.Sc. with the prescribed postgraduate diploma in Physics.
M.Tech., B.E., B.Tech., MCA, M.Sc. in Computer Science or other prescribed computer science qualifications, including specified DOEACC and postgraduate qualification combinations.
High School with Science and a Diploma in Laboratory Technology, or Intermediate with Science from a recognized board.
Intermediate or equivalent qualification, prescribed computer qualification and Hindi and English computer typing proficiency.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum and maximum age requirements will be calculated as of 1 April 2026. Principal candidates must be between 30 and 45 years of age, while candidates applying for other advertised posts must be between 25 and 45 years of age. Age calculation date: 1 April 2026. Maximum service age in Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas: 60 years. Reservation will be applicable according to the prescribed Uttar Pradesh Government provisions. The maximum service age of 60 years should not be confused with the maximum application age of 45 years.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026 Salary – Revised Honorarium
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly honorarium according to their appointed posts. Principal positions carry the highest honorarium of Rs. 30,000 per month, while subject teachers receive Rs. 22,000 per month. The salary table below incorporates the revised honorarium announced through the official corrigendum dated 26 November 2026. The notification states that the specified honorarium includes the employer's 13% EPF contribution for personnel whose honorarium falls within the Rs. 15,000 limit. Payments will be governed by instructions issued from time to time by the State Project Office, Lucknow. These are contractual honorarium amounts rather than regular government pay scales. Candidates should not assume that the advertised amounts represent their final in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process varies according to the post. Principal, PGT, Caretaker and Lab Assistant candidates will be selected on the basis of merit, while Office Superintendent/Clerk candidates must also qualify through a typing test. Peon, Watchman and Assistant Cook selection will be conducted through interviews. Selected candidates' educational and training certificates will be verified with the relevant boards and institutions. Original certificates must be produced during the interview or counselling process, as applicable. The notification does not announce a separate competitive written examination for these positions.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Maharajganj Merit List Calculation 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification prescribes a quality-point calculation method based on candidates' academic and training examination marks. The weightage varies according to the level of qualification. The above total is calculated from the individual weightages provided in the notification. Candidates should follow the merit calculation provisions applicable to their selected posts. If two or more candidates obtain equal quality points, the older candidate will be placed higher in the merit list. If both quality points and age are equal, candidates will be ranked according to the English alphabetical order of their names. Candidates whose marks are awarded in CGPA or SGPA format must attach the percentage conversion certificate issued by the concerned university.

rows.merit_calculation_formula: Percentage of Marks in Theory and Practical Examination × 30/100

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Applications for KGBV Maharajganj recruitment must be submitted offline using the prescribed application form. Candidates should ensure that their completed applications and supporting documents reach the designated office before the deadline. Visit the official Maharajganj district website at maharajganj.nic.in . Download the KGBV recruitment notification and revised honorarium corrigendum. Read the educational qualification, age limit and selection requirements for the relevant post. Print the prescribed application form available on page 6 of the notification document. Enter the post name, subject, personal details, contact information and educational qualifications. Affix a recent self-attested colour passport-size photograph. Complete the academic merit calculation details and experience information, where applicable. Attach self-attested copies of the required educational, training and supporting certificates. Enclose three self-addressed envelopes with PIN codes and postage stamps worth Rs. 56 each. Sign the declaration and verify the completed application. Mention the name of the applied post and subject on the outer envelope. Send the application through registered post or speed post to the District Basic Education Officer, Maharajganj. Ensure that the completed application reaches the office by 10 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Incomplete applications, applications containing errors and applications received after the deadline may be rejected. Candidates applying for multiple posts must submit separate applications.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Maharajganj Application Postal Address
content_sections.text: Candidates must send their completed application forms and supporting documents to the address specified in the official recruitment notification. Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Near Vikas Bhawan, Maharajganj District, Uttar Pradesh – 273303. The deadline refers to receipt of the application at the designated office, not merely the date of postal dispatch. Candidates should send their applications sufficiently in advance.

All applicable original certificates must be produced during the interview or counselling stage. The concerned authorities will verify the authenticity of educational and professional documents.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 96 vacancies: 5 Principal, 6 PGT Hindi, 5 PGT English, 5 PGT Mathematics, 5 PGT Biology, 6 PGT Chemistry and 8 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KGBV Maharajganj Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Page 6 of this notice; also on https://maharajganj.nic.in and the office notice board) and send it to Office of the District Basic Education Officer, near Vikas Bhawan, Maharajganj, PIN 273303, by registered post / speed post (ordinary post not accepted), to reach by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Principal: 30 to 45 years; PGT Hindi: 25 to 45 years; PGT English: 25 to 45 years; PGT Mathematics: 25 to 45 years; PGT Biology: 25 to 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 30000.00 for Principal, 22000.00 for PGT Hindi, 22000.00 for PGT English, 22000.00 for PGT Mathematics, 22000.00 for PGT Biology.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Class 8 pass (Peon, Watchman, Assistant Cook); High School with science and Diploma in Laboratory Technique or Intermediate science (Lab Assistant); Intermediate with computer qualification and typing (Office Superintendent / Clerk); postgraduate degree and B.Ed. (Caretaker); subject postgraduate degree or listed alternatives (PGT, Computer Science); trained MA/M.Sc with experience or alternatives (Principal). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only women candidates are eligible. Caretaker, Peon, Watchman, Assistant Cook: night stay in the school is mandatory. Caretaker, Peon, Watchman, Assistant Cook: candidate must not have a physical disability or a contagious disease. Office Superintendent / Clerk: Hindi typing 25 wpm and English typing 30 wpm on computer.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons dismissed from any service. Persons convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude. Insolvent persons. Men (only women may apply).

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Principal, PGT, Caretaker, Lab Assistant: direct merit. Office Superintendent: merit and typing test. Assistant Cook, Peon, Watchman: interview. Merit marks: High School % x 10/100, Intermediate % x 10/100, Graduation % x 20/100, Postgraduation % x 20/100.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on contract basis. Maximum age for service in Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas is 60 years. Honorarium payable as per instructions of the State Project Office, Lucknow, issued from time to time.
